Package com.userservice.app.model

Class UserSurvey

java.lang.Object
com.userservice.app.model.UserSurvey
@Entity public class UserSurvey extends Object
Represents a user's survey information in the system.

This class defines the UserSurvey entity, which stores additional details provided by a user regarding their personal circumstances and preferences. It maps to the "user_survey" table in the "userservice" schema of the database.

The UserSurvey entity includes:

  • id: A unique identifier for the survey (primary key), auto-generated.
  • user: A one-to-one relationship with the User entity, representing the user associated with this survey.
  • hasChildren: Indicates whether the user has children.
  • hasElderlyParents: Indicates whether the user has elderly parents.
  • maritalStatus: A many-to-one relationship with the MaritalStatus entity, representing the user's marital status.
  • title: A many-to-one relationship with the Title entity, representing the user's title.
  • interests: A many-to-many relationship with the Interest entity, representing the user's interests.

Key aspects:

  • Uses Jakarta Persistence annotations for entity mapping and relationship management.
  • Employs Lombok annotations to automatically generate boilerplate code such as getters, setters, and constructors.
  • Defines relationships with User, MaritalStatus, Title, and Interest entities.

Constructors:

  • No-args constructor for default initialization.
  • All-args constructor for full initialization of all fields, except the user.
